caveats: Local Linux diagnostic runs, not hosted CI measurements or a causal latency claim.
cProfile magnifies Python-level work; do not mix profiled and fresh-process wall timings. Cumulative function times overlap and must not be added.
Both primary profile cohorts use tmpfs work roots and fresh processes/materialized files. OS page caches and shared-host load are uncontrolled.
Initial three direct-process baseline samples are retained separately because they lack worker CPU instrumentation.
An exploratory after run used overlay work roots; retained as excluded-from-comparison observations because filesystem differs.

parity.policy_transport_normalization: Replace only each oracle WORK root with $WORK; no semantic field normalization.
